3. The present application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed by Applicant No. 1 - Smt. Simarjeet Kaur, wife of Sri Manendra Singh, and Applicant No. 2 - Manendra Singh, against Respondent No. 2- Vinod Kumar, son of Sri Bakhtawar Lal.

The Applicants seek quashing of the cognizance order dated 25.06.2025, passed in Criminal Case No. 465 of 2025, titled as "State vs.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The case arises out of FIR No. 0359 of 2024, dated 28.07.2024, registered under Sections 420, 468, 471, 504, 506, and 120B of the Indian Penal Code at Police Station Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
The Applicants also pray for quashing of the entire proceedings in the said criminal case, currently pending before the Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
4. Learned counsel for the Applicants states that the Applicants had previously sought protection through directions issued by a coordinate Bench.
It is submitted that the present matter, in which a trial is being conducted against the Applicants, is purely civil in nature.
Furthermore, it is submitted that three FIRs have been lodged, all pertaining to the execution of the same sale deed.

5. Admit.
6. Issue notice to the Respondent No. 2.
7. Steps to be taken within a week.
8. Let the objections be filed.
9.
